items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 16 at 1:28AM EST until November 18 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds gradually increasing to 20 to 30 knots
with gusts up to 35 knots and seas building through the period
to 7 to 12 feet.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...From 1 PM this afternoon to 7 PM EST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
